summary: Ruth's Chris Steak House is a chain of over 100 upscale steakhouses in the United States, Canada and Mexico, described as a fine dining establishment whose status has risen since its founding in the 1960s. The note says it is the largest luxury steakhouse company by number of locations, operating income and overall profit, ahead of The Palm and Morton's. On May 22, 2008, the company was rebranded and became part of Ruth's Hospitality Group after that group acquired Mitchell's Fish Market. The group is headquartered in Winter Park, Florida.
one_line: Ruth's Chris Steak House is a large upscale US, Canada and Mexico steakhouse chain now run under Ruth's Hospitality Group.
